observations: Three photos show a white window-type air conditioner wrapped in plastic.
The front panel has a label that reads 'Energy Saver' and 'BR'ING NATURE HOME Air-Conditioner'.
The brand 'SAMSUNG' is visible at the bottom of the front panel in all three photos.
The unit has a control panel with buttons and a small display on the right side.
The unit is placed on a metal stand with copper coils visible underneath, suggesting it is in a shop or storage area with other AC units.
The background shows multiple other air conditioners, some stacked, indicating a resale or second-hand environment.
No model number is visible on the front or sides in any photo.
The plastic wrap appears intact, suggesting the unit is not used, but the 'Tokunbo' label implies it is imported second-hand.

claims.evidence: The unit is wrapped in plastic and appears clean, but 'Tokunbo' means second-hand imported, and 'fresh' is subjective. No proof of recent import or condition beyond appearance.
